newsitem.title: USA: Culligan files 4.99 million share secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Culligan files 4.99 million share secondary offering.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc., a water purification and treatment products and services company, Monday filed a proposed offering of up to 4.99 million of its common shares with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Culligan said it will not receive proceeds from the secondary offering.
Of the total, investor Carl Icahn, a former director, plans to sell up to 3.45 million shares or 17.3 percent in the Northbrook, Ill.-based company, it said.
Investor Steve Green, also a former director, plans to sell up to 1.54 million shares, representing a 7.5 percent stake.
The offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co., Bear Stearns & Co. Inc., Natwest Securities Ltd., Smith Barney Inc. and Jefferies & Co.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 599,391 additional shares, the company said.
Culligan's stock fell 87.5 cents to $37.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
